notes.title: Crafting the Story of Ecumene Aztec
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, warriors and wanderers![/h1]

As our journey into the heart of Ecumene Aztec continues, it’s time to offer a peek behind the curtain—into the world of narrative design.

[h2]Into the Fire: Research Begins[/h2]

We’re diving deep into the vibrant world of the Aztec Empire—not as ruins, but as it truly was: alive, spiritual, dangerous. Our references include the Codex Mendoza, Codex Borgia, and The True History of the Conquest of New Spain. Each is a window into another time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44173279/514329d96d3a9d18dc328a9f45d998b60027d70b.jpg[/img]

Writing a narrative in this world means more than just getting the facts straight. It means feeling the world as it once was—and making it work within a game that demands stealth, action, and survival.

[h2]A Character Transformed[/h2]
Our protagonist begins as a low-caste sacrifice. But his name, like his role, will evolve. Revenge, rebirth, and a world on fire—he walks a path from nobody to someone far more… fearsome.
We’ve detailed his backstory, look, weapon preferences—even whether he’s the type to gamble or pray. This is personal storytelling in a very impersonal world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44173279/860a80c68fe225bda3172f68586e89d7ba40fe28.jpg[/img]

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]
The narrative backbone is almost complete. We’re finalizing the dialogue systems and planning key emotional moments… An exciting time lies ahead – the story is beginning to take an intriguing shape.
We’re working with consultants: [b]Polish writer Michał Gołkowski[/b], author of a book series set in the waning days of Aztec civilization.
Additionally, we’re collaborating with [b]Osvaldo Alexis Zúñiga Elizalde[/b], a native Nahuatl speaker who serves as our cultural consultant on Aztec heritage.

[h2]Final Thoughts[/h2]
Being a Narrative Designer means balancing history, emotion, gameplay, and myth. In Ecumene Aztec, we’re not just writing a script — we’re shaping a legend.

See you in the jungle. Or the temple. Or maybe at the altar with a fresh heart in the hand?
Do you have any questions for the Narrative Team? Feel free to ask in the comment section!
[i]— The Narrative Team @ Ecumene Games[/i]

notes.title: We have an exciting update on Ecumene Aztec!
notes.content:
The game is still in early development, so we pushed the premiere into the future and we will announce a new release date. We’ve recently made some significant changes in the game and partially restarted the production with a new development studio. Additionally, we've launched official social media accounts to keep you updated with the latest news and developments. We want to share with you some production information and cool facts about Aztecs.


BUT…. Most importantly for our dedicated fans, [b]we’ve started a Discord server[/b] where you can join the community, share your thoughts, and stay connected with fellow enthusiasts. Your support means everything to us, and we can't wait to share more updates soon!
